name: Google Tasks
author: Carl Kaufman
description: View, manage, and quick-add Google Tasks reminders from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Synced Google Tasks & reminders popup with quick-add, interactive completion checkboxes, due-date highlighting, and multi-list support.

schema.label: Task List Name
schema.description: The name or ID of the Google Tasks list to sync (e.g. 'Reminders', 'Work', 'My Tasks').

schema.label: Sync Interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often tasks are fetched in the background.

schema.label: Show completed tasks
schema.description: Show recently completed tasks at the bottom of the list.

schema.label: Bar badge counts
schema.description: 'all' counts all open tasks; 'due' counts only tasks due today or overdue; 'none' hides the badge.
